source: Fargo Courier branch and collection-point list supplied by the business, compiled from Fargo's published directories (2021-2024).
caveat: Fargo runs 100+ branches and reshuffles collection points regularly - host locations (petrol stations, malls) and phone numbers change. Confirm with the branch or the hub before routing a shipment. Coordinates are deliberately absent: nothing in this codebase reads a pickup station's latitude or longitude, and inventing them would put fabricated data in the database to satisfy a field no one looks at.
